How do NFTs work? 
At a very high level, most NFTs are part of the Ethereum blockchain. Ethereum is a cryptocurrency, like bitcoin or dogecoin, but its blockchain also supports those NFTs that store additional information that makes them work differently than, say, an ETH coin.
